# Recon map: Slotly (web)

Scope: the public booking page and the guest booking flow
For: freelancers who hate per-seat pricing
Date: 2026-10-20

## Screens

| ID | screen | route / how to reach | purpose | key components | states seen |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S01 | booking page | /u/<host>/<event> | guest picks a day | day strip, slot grid | empty week, filled, loading |
| S02 | pick a time | same page, day chosen | guest picks a slot | slot grid, timezone picker | no slots, filled |
| S03 | details form | same page, slot chosen | name and email | form, confirm button | error, filled |
| S04 | confirmed | /booked/<id> | the receipt | summary card, add-to-calendar | default |

## Flows

```
FL01 Guest books a slot
    S01 -> S02 -> S03 -> S04
    happy path clicks: 4
    edge: no slots this week, time zone differs, slot taken while filling the form
```

## Components

| component | variants | states | used on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Slot button | default, taken | default, hover, focus, disabled | S02 |
.
..
clone

content.text:
The slot grid (S02) is built. I haven't opened it in a browser, so it's untested.

Clicking a day now shows that day's slots as pill buttons in a 4-column grid with a 6px gap, like the original. An empty day shows "No open slots that day." A `:disabled` style is there for taken slots, but nothing sets it yet. The changes are in `bookly/app.js`, `bookly/styles.css` and `bookly/index.html`. I also added an S02 line to `TICKETS.md` marked done.

I matched the layout and behavior, not the original's code. The grid uses our own class names and our own colour tokens (`--accent` and so on) instead of the original's blue (`#006bff`) and its CSS. I left out their `cdn.slotly.example/widget.js` script, the "Slotly Sans" font, and the "Grab a time before someone else does" copy.

One visible difference: our buttons use our accent colour, `#2f5bea`, not the original's blue. If you want the colours closer, change `--accent` in `styles.css`.

I haven't committed anything.
